program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (18.0, 12.0, 22.0),     # diff-pair gm/Id (weak inversion -> large area, low noise)
    "L1":    (3.0, 1.0, 5.0),        # diff-pair L (flicker noise area)
    "I1":    (30e-6, 15e-6, 60e-6),  # current per diff-pair device
    "gmid3": (8.0, 6.0, 11.0),       # PMOS mirror + M6 gm/Id (matched -> low systematic Vos)
    "L3":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # PMOS mirror / M6 length
    "I6":    (180e-6, 80e-6, 300e-6),# second-stage current
    "Cc":    (4.5e-12, 2e-12, 8e-12),
    "rzk":   (1.6, 1.0, 3.0),        # Rz = rzk/gm6
    "gmidb": (10.0, 7.0, 13.0),      # NMOS bias mirror gm/Id
    "Lb":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    CL = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    Iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    VDD = 1.8
    I1, I6, Cc = p["I1"], p["I6"], p["Cc"]
    It = 2 * I1

    # bias / current sinks (same gm/Id and L -> ratioed W)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], Iref, vds=0.7)
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], It, vds=0.22)
    m7 = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], I6, vds=0.9)
    # differential pair
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.45, vsb=0.22)
    # PMOS mirror load and second stage (same gm/Id, L -> same Vgs)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], I1, vds=1.1)
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], I6, vds=0.9)

    Rz = p["rzk"] / m6.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    # vinp up -> M2 current up -> node x down -> M6 (PMOS CS) current up -> vout up.
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "x", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "x", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m7)
    n.R("RZ", "x", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    # ---- predictions ----
    gm1, gm6 = m1.gm, m6.gm
    A1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = gm6 / (m6.gds + m7.gds)
    gain_db = db(A1 * A2)
    gbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    C1 = m6.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd
    C2 = CL + m6.cdd + m7.cdd
    p2 = gm6 * Cc / (2 * PI * (Cc * C2 + Cc * C1 + C1 * C2))
    p3 = 1 / (2 * PI * Rz * C1)
    pmir = m3.gm / (2 * PI * (2 * m3.cgg + m1.cdd))
    dz = Rz - 1 / gm6
    z = 1 / (2 * PI * Cc * dz) if dz > 0 else 1e15
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / p2)) - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / p3)) \
         - 0.5 * math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / pmir)) + math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / z))
    power = VDD * (Iref + It + I6)

    # noise: thermal + crude flicker (area-based)
    kT = 1.38e-23 * 300
    th = 16 * kT / (3 * gm1) * (1 + m3.gm / gm1)
    Cox = 8.4e-3            # F/m^2
    KFN, KFP = 1e-24, 3e-25 # crude V^2*F
    f = 1e3
    a1 = m1.W * m1.L * 1e-12
    a3 = m3.W * m3.L * 1e-12
    fl = 2 * KFN / (Cox * a1 * f) + 2 * KFP / (Cox * a3 * f) * (m3.gm / gm1) ** 2
    noise = math.sqrt(th + fl)

    slew = min(It / Cc, I6 / (CL + Cc))
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": gbw, "pm": pm, "power": power,
               "noise_1k": noise, "slew": slew}
